decision_summary: The immutable proposal and validation bindings, current canonical base, complete 52-entry semantic read set, four-new-node and nine-new-edge write set, independently reconstructed candidate hash, typed graph, trusted-closure behavior, and protected-node policy all check exactly. The frozen proof and independent audit establish only the declared pointwise theorem: for every finite R>1, arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal min-law root with n=2 and mu=2, the dual scalar H is positive, hence the event-matrix inertia is (3 positive,1 negative,0 zero), det(L_-) is positive, J is negative, and partial_q A_2 is negative, without reflection. Exact symbolic and Bernstein replays pass, including two differently oriented cube coordinates, 539 rational Bernstein coefficients with 387 positive, 152 zero, and no negative coefficient, and byte-identical regeneration of both frozen output certificates. General mu, n>2, global min order or uniqueness, existence, compatible degenerate closures, and O3a remain open. No blocking or major finding remains.

ordered_step_reconstruction: Write the min event matrix as M=D+B^T K^(-1)B. Split the positive odd internal edges from the negative even edges: P=D+B_o^T K_o^(-1)B_o is positive definite and M=P-C^T W^(-1)C with W positive. Two Schur complements give n_-(M)=n_+(H) and n_0(M)=n_0(H) for H=CP^(-1)C^T-W. At n=2, H is the scalar beta_R+beta_L-|K_2|.
On the actual middle negative cell define x_*=(gamma_3-gamma_2)/|K_2|>0 from the exact time-translation jump. The identity Hx_*=E_L+E_R holds with E_L=beta_R x_*+gamma_2 and E_R=beta_L x_*-gamma_3.
For mu=2 use x=tan(theta_+/2), y=tan(theta_-/2), and r=sqrt(R). The trusted phase bounds put each physical interface in the strict chamber r>1 and 0<x<1/sqrt(3)<y<1.

Solve both independent momentum matching equations at a positive-negative interface. The exact amplitude ratios have physical sign conditions D_a>0 and N_b>0. The local right-interface identity follows by time reversal, but it is applied to the actual pair (x_3,y_2), separately from the actual left pair (x_1,y_2); no equality x_1=x_3 and no global reflection are used.

After substitution, both split gap numerators reduce to the same primitive polynomial P(x,y,r), with signed denominators: N_L=P/[x^3(1+x^2)(1+y^2)^2 D_a^3] and N_R=-rP/[x^2 y^2(x-y)(x+y)(1+x^2)^3(1+y^2)N_bD_a]. In the strict chamber every displayed denominator has the required sign.

Set X=x^2, Y=y^2, and kappa=rx(3Y-1)/[y(1-3X)]. Exact decomposition of N_b gives 0<kappa<kappa_N<1, while D_a/y exceeds its kappa=1 value 2X(Y-X)>0. Thus the physical domain lies inside the open box 0<X<1/3<Y<1 and 0<kappa<1. Direct cancellation gives P=y^4 Q(X,Y,kappa)/(3Y-1)^2.

Map the containing box to an open unit cube. Exact rational power-to-Bernstein conversion at degree (10,6,6) yields 539 coefficients: 387 positive, 152 zero, and 0 negative. The author map X=u/3 and the independent reversed map X=(1-a)/3 parameterize the same interval; both exact reconstructions pass. Since every tensor Bernstein basis function is strictly positive in the cube interior and at least one coefficient is positive, Q>0 and hence P>0 at every physical point.

Apply the interface result to the actual left pair and separately to the time-reversed actual right pair. Both refer to the same physical middle-cell invariant x_*, so E_L>0 and E_R>0 imply Hx_*>0 and H>0.

Because H is a positive scalar, the Schur inertia identity gives n_-(M)=1 and n_0(M)=0. The event matrix is 4-by-4, so the remaining three eigenvalues are positive; no additional unlisted one-sided estimate is required.

The determinant lemma gives det(M)=det(D)det(K^(-1))det(L_-). With det(D)>0, det(K)<0, and det(M)<0 from the proved inertia, det(L_-)>0. The trusted R7 bridge then gives J<0 and partial_q A_2<0 in the scaling quotient.

The dual inertia direction is n_-(M)=n_+(H), not n_-(H). Half-angle variables, squared variables, and the common middle-cell x_* are never conflated.

Local time reversal transfers the interface identity without imposing reflection and is applied separately at x_1 and x_3; the later sum is valid because both interfaces bound the same actual middle cell and therefore share the same x_*. The rational domain reduction proves strict denominator signs before cancellation. The Bernstein power-to-basis formula and inverse transform were replayed exactly, and an independently oriented cube map gives the same positivity conclusion. The determinant and R7 sign chain is noncircular.
